operating_notes.text: Received a Letter of Empanelment from MSEDCL for 15,000 Off-Grid DC Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems valued at ₹353.89 Cr (inclusive of GST), to be executed within 60 days.
CARE Ratings issued Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 confirming ₹400 Cr IPO proceeds fully utilized except ₹11.07 Cr unutilized.
GK Energy deployed 61,085 decentralized renewable energy systems and commissioned 276 MW during FY2025-26, taking cumulative installations to over 140,000 systems and 617 MW.
Management noted installed capacity of 15,000 systems per month and cumulative installations of 617 MW.
Installed 24,118 systems in Q1FY27, more than double YoY
Order book as on June 2026 was ₹541 Cr, including post-June orders
Rooftop solar currently 5% of revenue but 20% of order book
Received Letter of Award from MSEDCL for 14,000 solar water pumping systems worth ₹330.29 Cr (incl. GST) under Magel Tyala scheme, to be executed within 60 days of NTP.
Board approved reallocation of ₹19.10 million unutilised IPO proceeds from issue-related expenses to general corporate purposes.
Installed 19,391 systems (84 MW) in Q2FY27 and 43,509 systems (193 MW) in H1FY27.
Received ₹377.48 Cr cash post 30 September 2026, significantly lowering debtor balances.
Secured first utility-scale BESS order of 150 MW / 300 MWh in Maharashtra.

timeline.summary: GK Energy received a ₹353.89 Cr letter of empanelment from MSEDCL for 15,000 solar water pumps.
Shareholders approved Mr. Subhash Vasant Ghaisas (DIN: 11479724) as Non-Executive Independent Director via remote e-voting on May 09, 2026, with 99.9999% support.
GK Energy Limited’s **Mr. Gopal Kabra (Chairman, MD & CEO)** and **Mr. Sunil Kamalkishor Malu (CFO)** will present Q4 & FY 2026 earnings on May 13, 2026, at 04:30 PM IST via conference call.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹476.76 Cr, net profit ₹59.25 Cr.
GK Energy filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 confirming full IPO proceeds utilization of ₹400 Cr.
GK Energy announced FY26 financial results with revenue of ₹1,532.54 Cr and PAT of ₹201.27 Cr.
GK Energy Limited shared the audio recording link of its investor call on May 13, 2026, discussing audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results.
On May 19, 2026, GK Energy filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 13, 2026.
GK Energy held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 07, 2026, reporting 71.1% YoY revenue growth to ₹505 Cr and reaffirming FY27 doubling guidance
GK Energy received a ₹330.29 Cr Letter of Award from MSEDCL for 14,000 solar water pumps under the Magel Tyala scheme.
GK Energy Limited will hold Q2 & H1 FY2027 Earnings Conference Call on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 03.30 P.M. IST.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹408.65 Cr (+1.1% YoY), net profit ₹49.37 Cr (+5.2% YoY).
GK Energy released its Q2FY27 investor presentation, highlighting a ₹788 Cr order book and long-term 2030 vision.
GK Energy approved incorporating 5 wholly owned BESS subsidiaries, pending ROC approval.
Audio recording link of earnings conference call for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 made available on company website, effective October 29, 2026.
